testPlan.title: road runs: through junctions, lane ends, probe

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: A click takes the road on through its junctions
test.hint: Click a built road that crosses a junction: the outline and handles carry on past it, up to a T (ticks itself).

test.title: Moving a junction: its connectors follow
test.hint: Add a handle at a junction, drag it, right-click: side roads fade back to place within about 20 m, short turns bend and stay joined (ticks itself - check by eye).

test.title: A lane with a shorter twin pairs
test.hint: Click a two-lane road where one lane runs on past a junction the other does not, on the stretch where both run side by side: both lanes get handles (ticks itself).

test.title: Probe at the U bend of track_1
test.hint: Detection view, mouse on the ragged asphalt at the U bend, then the card's 'probe here' button: rings show decals near it (ticks itself; the paint read goes to the log).
